title: Capability Manager Discovery Spiral
objective: Run independent read-only BAGO agent audits of the current ADL candidate to define a safe capability manager controlled through the UI and chat. Preserve the current worktree and distinguish registered, available, eligible, authorized, executed, and verified states.

work_items.title: Audit capability ownership and architecture
read_scopes: candidate source tree: agents/**, src/**, frontend/src/**, docs/**
deliverables: Source-bound architecture report for capability catalog and authority boundaries
done_when: Findings cite active candidate HEAD and concrete symbols/files
Distinguish reference-only agent catalog from activated runtime
Recommend minimal capability-manager boundary without granting execution

work_items.title: Audit backend capability, policy, persistence and execution paths
read_scopes: candidate source tree: src/api/**, src/adapters/**, src/sandbox/**, src/execution/**, src/orchestration/**, tests/**
deliverables: Source-bound backend capability path and persistence report
done_when: Trace API, registry, permits, sandbox, gateway and receipts
Identify what is live versus merely present in code
No code or state is modified

work_items.title: Audit capability manager and chat UI integration points
done_when: Map current navigation, chat intent routing, API calls and state owners
Recommend low-cognitive-load UI and review flow
No code or state is modified

work_items.title: Synthesize findings into a reviewable capability manager contract
deliverables: Concrete capability manager MVP contract and implementation sequence
done_when: Names data model, API, UI/chat flows and review gates
Lists validation criteria and residual decisions
